# Usage Jump around S-TUN-002 due to Stadium Event

- **Classification:** expected_event
- **Root cause:** expected_event at `S-TUN-001`
- **Confidence:** high (Direct correlation between the timing of the external event EVT-001 and the KPI deviations observed across S-TUN-001, S-TUN-002, and S-TUN-003, with configuration changes ruled out via T5 and anomalies captured via T1 and T4. The maintenance calendar was NOT CHECKED.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-11 18:15 to 2026-09-11 21:45
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-11 18:18
- **Affected:** S-TUN-001, S-TUN-002, S-TUN-003

## Summary

A football match at Stade Olympique de Rades (EVT-001) caused a massive influx of spectators, leading to a traffic, active user, and PRB utilisation spike on S-TUN-002 and neighboring sites S-TUN-001 and S-TUN-003.

Active users, download volume, and PRB utilisation spiked above baseline on S-TUN-001, S-TUN-002, and S-TUN-003 between 2026-09-11 18:15 and 2026-09-11 21:45.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-11 18:15: Earliest KPI onset detected with S-TUN-003 dl_volume_mb above baseline [T4]
- 2026-09-11 18:18: Football match at Stade Olympique de Rades (EVT-001) starts [EVT-001]
- 2026-09-11 18:30: Detector alert ALR-0018 starts, noting traffic, active users, and PRB utilisation spikes on S-TUN-001, S-TUN-002, and S-TUN-003 [ALR-0018]
- 2026-09-11 18:45: Worst active users and download volume spikes observed on S-TUN-002 [ANM-000150, ANM-000151]
- 2026-09-11 19:00: Worst PRB utilisation spike observed on S-TUN-002 [ANM-000156]
- 2026-09-11 21:30: Detector alert ALR-0018 and most KPI deviations recover [ALR-0018, T4]
- 2026-09-11 21:43: External event EVT-001 ends [EVT-001]
- 2026-09-11 21:45: S-TUN-002 active users recover to baseline [T4]

## Evidence

- A detector alert ALR-0018 recorded traffic, active users, and PRB utilisation spikes on S-TUN-001, S-TUN-002, and S-TUN-003. [ALR-0018]
- An external event EVT-001 (football match at Stade Olympique de Rades) took place from 2026-09-11 18:18 to 2026-09-11 21:43. [EVT-001]
- No changes were performed on S-TUN-002, S-TUN-001, S-TUN-003 or their parents between 2026-09-11 17:00 and 2026-09-12 00:00. [T5]
- KPI query showed deviations across 9 of 9 series starting from 2026-09-11 18:15. [T4]

## Hypotheses

1. **expected_event** at S-TUN-001: confirmed. The timing of the stadium event EVT-001 directly matches the onset and recovery of traffic surges on S-TUN-002 and surrounding sites, with no configuration changes or equipment faults identified. [EVT-001, ALR-0018, T4]
2. **bad_change** at S-TUN-002: rejected. No configuration changes were applied to S-TUN-002 or its ancestors during the relevant time window. [T5]

## Ruled out

- T5: No configuration changes occurred on the affected sites or their parents during the window, ruling out a bad change.

## Recommended actions

- Monitor stadium event schedules in the TUN region to anticipate future localized traffic surges.
